text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A fierce battle on the straight course!!
Every Umamusume is launching into their final spurt!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Kh...! What's with this insanely
intimidating pressure coming at me from before...!?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I will win!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Kh, no way, seriously...!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—A new heroine has arrived! Almond Eye!!
Displaying breathtaking power, it's Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
The greatest feeling ever...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, no...!
Almond Eye is way too strong...!!
What an unbelievable Umamusume we have here!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky Lilac was so close!
Looks like sparks are really gonna fly between her and Almond Eye from now on...! Can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I was in top form... I didn't let my guard down at all... The strategy was perfect... And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(She totally outdid me...!
Ai-san was simply stronger...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (My... total defeat—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh...!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Switch gears... switch gears...! Lady Luck just wasn't on my side this time...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I will DEF-I-NITE-LY use this frustration next time...!
So for now, hold your head high...!)
—Lala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Lara!
Thanks to you, I gave it my absolute best today...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
......Congratulations, Ai-san.
You truly showed me your strength.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's race again!
Because next time, I'm definitely going to win!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Because surely this isn't all you've got, right? You're going to get even... stronger, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (W-Well aren't you bold...!! That's just like you, Ai-san...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Still... fine by me.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—At the next Oaks...
I will have my revenge.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: You'd better be ready.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes...!
I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Lucky Lilac's Oka Sho
ended in a frustratingly close result—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...The reason for this defeat. It wasn't carelessness or anything;
I think Ai-san was simply one step ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Eye's performance at the Oka Sho far exceeded my wildest expectations... To think she had that much speed in her...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye's running far surpassed all prior predictions. This was entirely my oversight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her speed, in particular, conceals an astounding potential.
Countermeasures will be an absolute necessity for the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I will never, ever misjudge them again.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let's leave nothing to chance and win this time.
I'll be counting on your guidance.
choice_data_list: Yeah, we're definitely getting our revenge...!
Yeah, we'll definitely get our revenge...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward the next decisive battle, the Yushun Himba (Oaks).
This time, the tiara will be in her grasp—
